messages:
Mia G: quick sync — we need final social plan for next Wed's feature + webinar (11am PT). Goal: drive signups and capture high-intent leads. Can we finalize copy, assets, and routing by EOD?

Devin P: happy to own copy. proposing: A/B test two LinkedIn headlines (1. product-first) vs (2. benchmark-first). For X, we'll run a concise 4-tweet thread + pinned TL;DR.

Samir K: design can deliver hero + 2 quote-card variants + 1 looping 6s perf GIF. ETA for first drafts: 3pm PT. Need precise numbers for the chart.

Jordan T: benchmark top-lines for the launch: up to 42% median p95 latency reduction on real customer traces; up to 28% cost/unit improvement after batching + quant presets. Use cautious language: "up to" and include sample size note in long form.

Mia G: add a single-sentence note: "Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." helps enterprise folks. Also create a short bullet for reliability fallbacks.

Devin P: copy proposals below. Keep short for X; longer for LinkedIn with methodology callout and webinar CTA.

Devin P: X thread (4 posts):
Devin P: 1) Were shipping runtime updates that cut latency and cost for production LLMs. 680
Devin P: 2) In internal benchmarks customers saw up to 42% lower p95 latency vs baseline.
Devin P: 3) Up to 28% lower cost/unit via workload-aware batching + quantization profiles.
Devin P: 4) Watch the webinar 3/31 11am PT for demos + tuning tips 4C5 https://redwood.ai/webinar — pinned TL;DR + signup.

Devin P: LinkedIn variant A (headline: Product):
Devin P: "Faster, cheaper inference for production LLMs — now in Redwood Inference's latest runtime." Then 2-3 bullets with numbers and a line: "Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA to webinar.

Devin P: LinkedIn variant B (headline: Benchmark):
Devin P: "Up to 42% lower p95 latency and up to 28% lower cost/unit in real workloads." Short methodology note + webinar CTA.

Mia G: good. let's put both live and let paid ad favor the headline that gets higher CTR in first 6hrs. Budget: $2k paid boost first 48hrs; target: NA + EU mid-market infra/product buyers.

Lina S: routing & tracking checklist: add utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_3_31 and paid uses utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=launch_3_31_paid. Add hidden form field "company_size_bracket" and capture ARR estimate when available. HubSpot mapping planned.

Lina S: SDR routing rules (simple):
- If company_size_bracket=enterprise OR ARR >= 1000000 -> assign to SDR-enterprise
- If ARR between 250000 and 999999 -> assign to SDR-midmarket
- Else -> marketing nurture list

Lina S: Engagement templates (short):
- Public reply: "Thanks! Demo + sign-up: https://redwood.ai/webinar 4C5 What model/seq len are you using?"
- Short DM for product interest: "Hi <name> 44B Can we hop 15 mins this week? Also curious which model & avg seq len you run."
- Auto-reply (low-effort): "Thanks for the interest — we'll follow up by email within 48h if you left a contact."

Samir K: uploaded design drafts to drive: /design/launch-assets/v1 (hero_A.png, hero_B.png, perf_gif.mp4, quote_cards_v1.psd). Will push final assets by 4:30pm PT.

Devin P: scheduling CSV for Hootsuite/Buffer (placeholders below). We'll swap copy + media names once final.

Devin P: platform,post_time,copy,media,hashtags,utm
X,1792053600,"Thread start...","perf_gif.mp4","#inference #LLMops","utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_3_31"
LinkedIn,1792053600,"LinkedIn A copy...","hero_A.png","#AI #MLOps","utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_3_31"
LinkedIn,1792057200,"LinkedIn B copy (benchmark)...","hero_B.png","#AI #MLOps","utm_source=social&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=launch_3_31_paid"

Mia G: posting windows: 11:00 PT (live/pinned), 15:00 PT (boost), 08:00 PT next day (APAC). Good for reach.

Devin P: will pin the TL;DR tweet and schedule three pushes. Also will create a small variant that tags the webinar CTA earlier for conversion testing.

Samir K: about quote cards—do we have permissions for logos and verbatim quotes? Need legal ok before publishing.

Jordan T: reached out to customers. Two ok with anonymized quotes, one requested logo removal. Sending legal the consent forms now.

Legal: received consent forms; will review and reply by 3pm PT. No major blockers expected.

MarketingBot: Reminder: "Launch assets + routing rules due by EOD" (automated)

Mia G: final checklist: copy A/B (Devin) [x], assets (Samir) [in progress], customer approvals (Jordan) [in progress], UTMs & HubSpot routing (Lina) [x], paid audiences & budget (Lina) [x].

Devin P: once legal clears, I'll queue posts and drop post IDs here. Also will create a shared sheet to log social replies + assign "engage-high" tags for SDRs to action within 24h.

Lina S: I'll wire the HubSpot workflow: social form -> tag -> route. Will post the workflow screenshot here when done.

Mia G: thanks everyone 44F let's reconvene if any approvals slip. We'll monitor replies during the webinar and route leads immediately.
